seo.title: ATV Quad Ride Koh Lanta | Secret Travel & Tour
seo.metaDescription: ATV on Koh Lanta: 30 minutes on a closed track, 1 or 2 hours on 250 cc ATVs to Lung Sod Beach, or ATV plus mangrove kayak. From 1,200 THB, transfer included.

lead: Thirty minutes on a closed track to learn, one or two hours on the trails of Koh Lanta Noi to Lung Sod Beach, or an hour of ATV followed by an hour of kayak in the mangrove.
promise: Trails to Lung Sod Beach, or a closed track to learn

facts.value: 30 min on a closed track, 1 hr to Lung Sod Beach, 2 hrs to Lung Sod Beach and the Siri Lanta Bridge, or 1 hr ATV plus 1 hr kayak

steps.label: 30 min
steps.text: Rides start every hour between 08:30 and 17:00, on a closed ATV track where the staff first show you how to drive.

steps.label: 1 h
steps.text: A short practice on the track, then the forest trails of Koh Lanta Noi. The ride ends at the viewpoint over Lung Sod Beach, with time for photos and the sand.

steps.label: 2 h
steps.text: A short practice on the track, then the trails of Koh Lanta Noi to Lung Sod Beach and the Siri Lanta Bridge, with stops for photos and time on the sand.

steps.label: 2 h
steps.text: One hour of ATV in the forest, then one hour of kayak in the mangrove of Thung Yee Peng. Watch for fiddler crabs, mudskippers, birds and monkeys.

included: On the 30-minute, 1-hour and 2-hour rides: raincoat, first aid kit, and insurance for rider and passenger (damage to the ATV is not covered)
Kayak and life jacket on the ATV and kayak ride

bring: Clothes that can get dusty or wet
beforeYouBook.children: No children under 4. The child price runs from 4 to 12. On the ATV and kayak ride, child riders are 6 to 12.
beforeYouBook.cancellation: Cancel at least 24 hours ahead. Later than that, half the ride is charged.

faq.a: Children from 4 to 12 pay the child price, as rider or passenger. On the ATV and kayak ride, children drive from 6. Under 4 cannot come.

The 30-minute track is for beginners and a first try. The one-hour ride goes to Lung Sod Beach and the two-hour ride adds the Siri Lanta Bridge; the ATV and kayak ride adds the mangrove by kayak. The longer rides are for experienced ATV riders only.
The rides are not recommended if you are pregnant, or if you have heart disease, epilepsy or another health condition.
